    level="1"
    right="Feat 14"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Precise Hooks](/Feats.aspx?ID=5449) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Archetype" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=535" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 69

**Archetype** [Clawdancer](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=221)

**Prerequisites**
[Clawdancer Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=5436)

</column>

---

Your body is a varied and deadly weapon. When you critically hit a target with your claw or talon, you can apply a critical specialization effect based on the stance you're in. For claw stance, apply the [knife](/WeaponGroups.aspx?ID=9) weapon group's effect. For talon stance, apply the [axe](/WeaponGroups.aspx?ID=1) group's effect. These effects are in addition to the claw's or talon's normal critical specialization effect if you apply it.
